## Overview

::: {.callout-important}
## Focus for today
This lab is **Phase 2** of the [Project Toolkit](project/project-toolkit.qmd). You will **finalise materials**, **complete the Researcher Procedure**, **practice running the study** on each other, and complete the **Research Study Order Form**. There is **no Week 19 lab** (testing); **Week 20** is data collection. Everything must be ready after this session.
:::

---

## Before You Start

1. Bring your **Phase 1 drafts** (Information Sheet, Consent, Debrief, Participant Instructions, Researcher Procedure draft).
2. Open the [Project Toolkit](project/project-toolkit.qmd) and have the **templates** for documents 4, 5, 6, 9 to hand.
3. Agree who will run the practice (researcher vs participants) and who will take notes on timing and clarity.

---

## Phase 2 Checklist

Use this checklist as you work. Tick off each item as your group completes it.

### 4. Recruitment Script

- [ ] Downloaded template: [Recruitment Script — Template](../../files/project-docs/templates/template-recruitment-script.docx)
- [ ] Script is 3–4 sentences: who you are, what the study is (briefly), how long, where to go, incentive if any
- [ ] Friendly and clear; printed or saved for use on data collection day
- [ ] Saved

**Reference:** [Project Toolkit](project/project-toolkit.qmd) → 4. Recruitment Script.

---

### 5. Data Recording Sheet

- [ ] Downloaded template: [Data Recording Sheet — Template](../../files/project-docs/templates/template-data-recording-sheet.docx)
- [ ] Columns: participant number, condition (if between-subjects), DV score, optional demographics
- [ ] **Scoring guide** included so all scorers use the same rules
- [ ] Deleted the between- or within-subjects table you don't need
- [ ] Saved

**Reference:** Project Toolkit → 5. Data Recording Sheet.

---

### 6. Stimulus Materials

- [ ] Downloaded or created materials: [Stimulus Materials — Template](../../files/project-docs/templates/template-stimulus-materials.docx) or project-specific (word lists, images, etc.)
- [ ] Materials **matched across conditions** (e.g. word frequency, difficulty, length)
- [ ] Tested on each other; any changes noted
- [ ] Final version saved and ready to print or display

**Reference:** Project Toolkit → 6. Stimulus Materials; [Project Options](project/group-project-options.qmd).

---

### 7. Participant Instructions (finalise if needed)

- [ ] Reviewed and updated from Phase 1 if the procedure changed
- [ ] Numbered steps, plain language, no hypothesis
- [ ] Separate sheets for between vs within if your procedures differ
- [ ] Saved

**Reference:** Project Toolkit → 7. Participant Instructions.

---

### 8. Researcher Procedure — Complete

- [ ] **Completed** the procedure you started in Phase 1
- [ ] **Data recording**: when and how you fill in the Data Recording Sheet (e.g. after each participant)
- [ ] **Scoring**: how you score the DV; reference to the scoring guide on the Data Recording Sheet
- [ ] **Full script**: exact words for greeting, instructions, debrief (in quotes)
- [ ] **Timing**: every phase has a duration
- [ ] **Materials checklist**: everything needed before each session
- [ ] Any group member could run the study from this document alone
- [ ] Saved

**Reference:** Project Toolkit → 8. Researcher Procedure.

---

### 9. Research Study Order Form

- [ ] Downloaded template: [Research Study Order Form — Template](../../files/project-docs/templates/template-research-study-order-form.docx)
- [ ] Listed **every document** and **number of copies** (e.g. Consent × 30, Debrief × 30)
- [ ] Included **special requirements** (e.g. colour printing, paper size)
- [ ] Included **consumables** (pens, blank paper, snacks)
- [ ] **Submit to Gordon by end of Week 19** (no lab that week — submit in your own time)
- [ ] Saved and submitted

**Reference:** Project Toolkit → 9. Research Study Order Form.

---

## Practice Run

::: {.callout-warning}
## Essential
Run the full study at least **once** within your group before data collection day.
:::

**Steps:**

1. **Researcher**: One person runs the study using the Researcher Procedure (consent → instructions → task → debrief). Use a timer.
2. **Participants**: Others take part as participants; follow the Participant Instructions.
3. **Data**: Record "data" on the Data Recording Sheet; use the scoring guide.
4. **Debrief**: Note what was unclear, too slow, or too fast. Did the instructions make sense?
5. **Update**: Revise the Researcher Procedure and/or Participant Instructions with any fixes.
6. **Swap** (if time): Another person runs it to check consistency.

---

## Consistency and Order Form

- **Study title** still consistent across all documents?
- **Procedure** in the Information Sheet still matches the final Researcher Procedure?
- **Order Form** lists everything you will need on the day (including spare copies)?

---

## What's Next

- **Week 19**: Lecture only (no lab). EDS due 20 March. Finalise any documents; **submit Research Study Order Form** by end of week.
- **Week 20**: Lecture + **data collection lab** — run your study with real participants.

---

## Key Takeaways

1. Phase 2 = Recruitment Script, Data Recording Sheet, Stimulus Materials, **complete** Researcher Procedure, practice run, Research Study Order Form.
2. The **practice run** catches unclear instructions, timing issues, and scoring problems before data collection.
3. Submit the **Order Form** by end of Week 19 so printing/resources can be ready for Week 20.
